description: The tips shown on the game-over screen, at most 16. image: the picture file in TIM/ without extension (TIPS_E01 = TIM/TIPS_E01.TIM). dark: true marks a tip favoured in dark scenes (weight 3 there and 1 in lit ones; tips without it the other way round). The save remembers seen tips as a 16-bit set by position in this list, so keep the order. A mod changes it with a file of the same path in its own folder; objects are merged key by key, so the patch only needs the keys it changes.
